snippet.title: Psalm 34 (When I See Your Face)
snippet.description:
'Psalm 34' is part of the Jubilee Church 'The Psalms of Summer' worship collective

These worship songs accompany our 'Psalms of Summer' sermon series. Each song is based on one of the books of Psalms. As David wrote songs to express his love for God and at times, his need for rescue and forgiveness, we also express our need for Him in our lives!

We pray that these songs help usher you into a deeper connection with God through His Holy Spirit.

Lyrics:

I’ve been remembering the way things were 
Ever since I was a child 
Shame was constant 
Always by my side 
I believed I was reviled 

I cried many lonely tears
Pinned down by all my fears

I hid my face 
Ooos

Even when I thought I cried alone 
There was someone listening all along
He heard this poor girl cry and pulled me in 
I never felt so warm
 
He said you’re not alone 
Come, let me hold you close

Let me see your face
Ooos

Now the one that I hid from 
Is the one that I run to
The one that I run to
Now the shame that hid my face
Is turned into glory
Turned into glory
(When I see your face)
Ooos

Even before I knew You 
Even before I could say Your name 
You were planning my days
And You don’t fail 
No, You don’t make mistakes
You turn shame into praise
And you are always making a way 

For me to lift my face
